title: Daily Temperatures - Solution
approach: Monotonic stack comparison and index tracking.
intuition: Given an array of integers temperatures represents the daily temperatures, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after the i-th day to get a warmer temperature.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Monotonic stack comparison and index tracking.
common_mistakes: Use a monotonic decreasing stack storing indices of temperatures.
